contexts.text: The outward man may be called the overseer or administrator of the house.
To administer = to discharge duties or employments.
The natural mind is what ministers and administers. Explained.

As Priests are governors to administer what is of Divine law and worship, so are Kings and Magistrates to administer what is of civil law and judgment. AC 10800. AC 10802. NJHD 319. NJHD 320. NJHD 322.
There are many administrations in Heaven; ecclesiastical, civil and domestic. HH 393:3. CL 207:2. TCR 403:end.
The administrations of the Angels. Explained.
Honoured according to the dignity of the affairs he administers.
The person... is for the sake of the thing he administers, and not contrariwise.
The uses in the administration and discharge of which they are.
With us a priest administers betrothals.
The administrators in Heaven seen. TCR 694:2.
Although a kingdom is divided into a number of administrations.
Taxes are collected for administration by officials etc.
The duties that belong to education and administration at home...
To introduce into a city a form of the administration of justice from judgment.
